notes.id: Sumber memuat dua rincian (sekolah juga membuka kelas tahfidz): Rp22.075.000, SPP Rp895.000, herregistrasi Rp4.880.000; dan Rp23.380.000, SPP Rp1.200.000, herregistrasi Rp4.980.000. Uang pangkal di sini = uang pangkal dll + annual fee (sesuai sumber). SPP belum termasuk ekskul dan antar jemput.
notes.en: The source gives two breakdowns (the school also runs a tahfidz class): Rp22,075,000, tuition Rp895,000, re-registration Rp4,880,000; and Rp23,380,000, tuition Rp1,200,000, re-registration Rp4,980,000. Entry fee here = entry fee etc. + annual fee (as given by the source). Tuition excludes extracurriculars and transport.
